name: se7enxweb/owmigration
description: OWMigration for Exponential: versioned up and down migrations for content classes, roles, workflows and object states, run from the command line, with an admin tab that generates the migration code from the existing definitions

suggest.ext-zip: Needed by the Export all buttons of the code generator
suggest.se7enxweb/owscriptlogger: Required at run time: the OWScriptLogger extension (https://github.com/se7enxweb/OWScriptLogger), which every migration step logs through
